findings.title: Neither R06 nor R07 has a command-level demonstration of an actual failing violation/test in the runner evidence.
findings.evidence: Manifest exit 2/127 entries are the disclosed environment gap (missing ts/node_modules because dev's own runner lacks the cd ts && npm ci setup step this phase adds), not a deliberately introduced violation.
findings.consequence: Both conditions are judged here from the diff, the config, and the Session Manager's own post-npm ci run rather than from a command this review ran itself.
